question: Identify the top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories based on their highest composition values across all months. For each category, display the time(MM-YYYY), interest name, and the composition value
sql:
-- Top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories based on their highest composition values
WITH max_composition AS (
    SELECT 
        imt.interest_id,
        MAX(imt.composition) AS max_composition
    FROM interest_metrics imt
    WHERE imt.composition IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY imt.interest_id
),
matched AS (
    SELECT 
        imt.month_year AS time,
        im.interest_name,
        imt.composition
    FROM interest_metrics imt
    JOIN interest_map im ON imt.interest_id = im.id
    JOIN max_composition mc ON imt.interest_id = mc.interest_id AND imt.composition = mc.max_composition
),
top10 AS (
    SELECT time, interest_name, composition
    FROM matched
    ORDER BY composition DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
bottom10 AS (
    SELECT time, interest_name, composition
    FROM matched
    ORDER BY composition ASC
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT time, interest_name, composition FROM top10
UNION ALL
SELECT time, interest_name, composition FROM bottom10
ORDER BY composition DESC
